_about: Approved source registry for The Newsren (Discover). Every feed URL below was verified on 2026-10-27 with a descriptive User-Agent and returned parseable RSS/Atom/JSON. Agents may only retrieve from sources listed here (plus the primary-record allow-list in newsren.ingest.sources). URL placeholders {max_items}, {edgar_count} (EDGAR page size: 10/20/40/80/100), {year} and {prev_year} are expanded at fetch time; results are then trimmed to max_items_per_source.

excluded.name: CISA cybersecurity advisories (cisa.gov/cybersecurity-advisories/all.xml, cisa.gov/news.xml)
excluded.reason: HTTP 403 from the CDN for automated clients with a descriptive User-Agent at verification time; cisa.gov stays on the primary allow-list for agent lookups. NCSC news is used for advisories instead.

excluded.name: US Department of Education press releases (ed.gov)
excluded.reason: HTTP 403 for automated clients at verification time.

excluded.name: FINRA site-wide feed (finra.org/rss.xml)
excluded.reason: Mixes years-old FAQ pages and bare PDF names; the News Releases feed is used instead.
